notes.title: Thrift Shop Preview Available
notes.notes:
Ready to try some thrift shopping? Willing to help find bugs and suggest gameplay improvements? Then request access to [b]Thrift Shop Preview[/b]. A limited number of play testers will be granted temporary access to the game for feedback. Feel free to discuss bugs and ideas in the community forum.  Please keep all discussions civil and respectful.

Thank you and enjoy!
[b]-Steve[/b]
